title: InvisibilityHotbarCleaner
description: This mod auto-moves revealing items from your hotbar to your inventory when you go invisible. This prevents your position from being exposed by a picked-up item or a block held in your hand.
body:
Many of you have faced this on servers: you're quickly looting a chest while under an Invisibility potion, when suddenly another player spots you. Because a random block or item landed in your hotbar, your stealth is blown, you get killed, and you lose everything you gathered at the event.

This mod automatically transfers revealing items (blocks, resources, junk) from your hotbar to your inventory as soon as you gain the Invisibility effect. This ensures your position won't be exposed by a randomly picked-up item or a block forgotten in your hand.
